parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
Controls which fields are returned for each Custom Field Definition.
'with_configurable_field_sets' additionally includes the configurable_field_sets array listing the field sets that use the defin...

id.description: Unique identifier for the Custom Field Definition. Use as the {id} path parameter for show, update, and delete requests.

label.description: Human-readable name of the Custom Field shown to users.

active.description: Whether the Custom Field Definition is active. Inactive definitions are retained but not offered for new field set configuration.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this Custom Field Definition. Matches the company_id path parameter used to scope the request.

data_type.description: The kind of value the Custom Field stores. One of: string, decimal, boolean, lov_entry (single select), lov_entries (multi select), datetime, rich_text, login_information, login_informations, vendo...

variant.description: Sub-type that refines the data_type (e.g. currency for decimal, radio_button for lov_entry, read_only for rich_text). Null when the data_type has no variant.

description.description: Optional longer description explaining the purpose of the Custom Field.

default_value.description: Default value pre-populated for the Custom Field. Only set for read_only rich_text fields; null otherwise.

configurable_field_sets_count.description: Number of Configurable Field Sets that use this Custom Field. Only present when includes_configurable_field_sets_count=true is passed; null otherwise.

configurable_field_sets.description: Configurable Field Sets that use this Custom Field. Only present when view=with_configurable_field_sets is requested.

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field. The supported variants is dependent on the data_type.

active.description: Whether the custom field is active or not.

default_value.description: The default value for the Custom Field. Only accepted for read_only rich_text fields.

custom_field_lov_entries.description: Custom Lov Entries (selectable options) for the custom field.
